entry_points.text: VT dispatch for APICv refresh, EOI load, machine-check, task-state, identity-map and SMEP gives benign trust-domain defaults and otherwise delegates to VMX helpers.
VT dispatch for L2 TSC query and update, host-timer arm and cancel, and memory-encryption ioctl suppresses trust-domain effects or rejects misuse and otherwise delegates.
VT dispatch for TDX vCPU commands and mapping level accepts only trust domains; module init sizes shared vCPU state and advertises TDX, teardown restores L1D and address state.
VMX bringup validates support, prepares descriptors and shared state, selects flush mitigation with per-CPU tracking, and checks nested layout; posted-wakeup starts empty and protected.

exports.text: VMX host helpers manage APIC access page, APICv refresh, EOI maps, real-mode task state, identity mapping, TSC offset and scaling, host timer arm and cancel, and machine-check validity.

Trust-domain services handle VM commands for capabilities, init and finalize, locked and unlocked vCPU commands for CPUID, creation and memory seeding, and mapping caps for shared versus private pages.

hazards.text: APIC stays quiet on missing slots and faults with one-time warning and deferral; task state propagates copy and region errors unless unrestricted; timer reports range overflow and rejects trust-domain use.

Management rejects flag, size, reserved, count, busy, mask, CPUID, width and module faults distinctly; user copies and allocations can fail; partial creation unwinds tail only with split ownership and progress writeback can override status.
Execution reads signal failure only by log and zero; CPUID first-half failure is I/O error while isolated second-half failure is unexpected; seeding checks signals and reschedules per page.

Flush without assist allocates a power-of-two buffer with distinct fill and fails without mode update on shortage; old hardware drops counter loads and entry-exit mismatches warn, clear both sides and may fail strictly.

invariants.text: APIC access needs enabled virtualization and a valid internal slot, samples invalidation around faulting, then defers on contention or publishes without pinning; refresh follows active state and EOI loads only when active.

Task state is skipped when unrestricted, else a small cleared private region with permission metadata is installed; timer derives a bounded scaled delta with overflow checks; machine-check validity tracks guest capability.

Capability query needs clear flags and room for all module CPUID entries; templates derive from module tables with sentinel fixup, forced width reporting on one extended leaf, and clearing of two feature families.

Init needs uninitialized state, clear flags, bounded stable counts, clear reserved areas, no vCPUs and in-mask attributes; setup applies fixed bits, TSC frequency, EPT controls for two widths, size-checked copies, and fully consumed CPUID with unsupported rejection.

Creation allocates key, accounting and pages with per-package online coverage and distinct entropy, operand and module errors; finalize, vCPU create, hardware bringup, seeding alignment and coverage, and CPUID bounds, sizing and subleaf probing each enforce state.

VMCS config derives controls from hardware masks, prunes inconsistent features, enforces entry-exit pairing, validates region size and caching, adjusts 32-bit and 64-bit controls differently, sanitizes enlightened use, checks support, and orders bringup before flush choice with build variants.

Shadow tables pair encoding with image offset for read-only and read-write views; bitmaps separate read and write; diagnostics use module prefix and flags; field lifting, single-value bug reporting, metadata pass-through and execution reads are narrow helpers.

locks.text: APIC access and refresh hold vCPU control protection with read cover around publish-or-defer; task-state creation serializes with the VM slot lock.

VM commands guard init and finalize but not capability query; creation holds CPU read cover and a global mutex; hardware vCPU init holds MMU write lock and unlocked commands use a scoped VM guard with load bracketing.
Per-CPU posted-wakeup list and its protection are initialized together before scheduling use.

state_machines.text: Trust domain goes unassigned to assigned to runnable, rejecting query, create, seeding and finalize once runnable; vCPU goes uninitialized to initialized to runnable, allowing seeding only while initialized.
APIC access defers on contention or publishes; host deadline arms to host time plus delta with expired mark at zero and sentinel on cancel; VT ops default or stay silent for trust domains.

Flush choice uses no-flush fast paths then resolves automatic policy to never, conditional or always with override and indicators; nested success clears status flags and advances past the instruction.

structs.text: Params carry CPU counts, attributes, features, TSC frequency, EPT controls, indexed CPUID and measurements; envelopes carry selector, flags, payload and error; plus capabilities, seeding progress, and VM and vCPU lifecycle, key, timing and address state.

Op tables select VT or VMX handlers with TDX-only resolution and a fixed inhibit set; nested image offsets are build-asserted; shadow descriptors and interception bitmaps separate read-only, read-write, read and write views.

ABI fixes TSC units, three-page task area, widths 48 and 52 with levels, init sizes, leaf-seven filtering with sentinel handling, TDX selectors, APICv inhibits, CPUID limits and flags, posted-interrupt fields, and VPID extents with timer rate.
